title: INFLATION WARNING: DO NOT GET TRAPPED RIGHT NOW!
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: PPI came in at 6.3% vs 5.4% expected, one of the worst reports in a while, likely to pass through to consumers.
FedWatch still shows ~69% odds of a pause; watching whether that shifts.
Middle East escalation and inflation could still drive markets lower before they improve.

calls.reason: Markets oversold and rallying off the open, but hot PPI and Middle East risks mean the bounce is likely to be given back; long-term direction favors bulls.
calls.quote: I still think it's early. I still think that markets can actually technically get worse before they get better.

calls.reason: Oversold with low forward P/E; buy the dip in small size for the long term, but expect the 7% bounce to pull back.
calls.quote: Micron at the lows of like 900 or you know, 875... I want to buy maybe one share.

calls.condition: If BTC breaks below 80,000 again (maybe over the weekend), expects a big gap down, MSTR included.
calls.reason: BTC briefly broke below 80k; a sustained break would drag MSTR much lower.
calls.quote: if BTC breaks below that 80,000 mark again, maybe over the weekend, that's a big gap down. MSTR has a long way to go.

notes: Date not stated; 'today's PPI' suggests the PPI release day. MSTR downside folded into the BTC call (conditional). CRWV/NBIS called oversold but he doesn't believe in them, so skipped. Micron 1,000/1,100 take-profit figures were hypothetical examples, not targets.
